name: expense-api
description: Owns expense claims and the team weekly limit. Stores each claim's amount, receipt reference, merchant, date, category and status; lets an employee submit and track their own claims; lets a manager list, approve and reject their team's claims and set/read the team's weekly limit. Does not read receipt images or interpret natural language itself — expense-webapp calls the agents for that and sends this service only the resulting structured values. Notification of an outcome is in-app: an employee sees the updated status the next time they read their own claims, so this service sends no email. Exposed to the internet because the browser SPA calls it directly.
